{{unknown name}} [[File:Director AG165.png|thumb|right|250px|The Director]] The '''Director''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG165|King and Queen for a Day!]]''. Since he was not given an official name, he will be henceforth referred to as "the Director" within the context of this article. The Director works on the television program ''King and Queen'' which features a {{p|Bonsly}} playing the King, and a {{p|Mime Jr.}} playing the Queen. He works with staff such as a Filmer and a Soundman. {{an|Brock}}'s {{TP|Brock|Bonsly}} and [[James]]'s {{TP|James|Mime Jr.}} were mistaken as the king and queen. ==Pokémon== ===Takes care of=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Director |pkmn=Mime Jr. |gender=female |type1=Psychic |img=Director Bonsly Mime Jr.png |epnum=AG165 |epname=King and Queen for a Day! |vajp= |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc=The director cast {{p|Mime Jr.}} to become the Queen of the television program, ''King and Queen''. Mime Jr. was given the name "Queen Mime Jr.," as the character name of the program. None of Mime Jr.'s moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Director |pkmn=Bonsly |gender=male |type1=Rock |img=Director Bonsly Mime Jr.png |epnum=AG165 |epname=King and Queen for a Day! |vajp= |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc=The director casted {{p|Bonsly}} to become the King of the television program, ''King and Queen''.
